meta.notes: Eng locked baseline: fixed premium per product, tiered payouts by traveler-selected threshold. Threshold minutes (tau) are INTERNAL only — never show in traveler UI. House is sole counterparty. Sell only when flight-level p_hat is under underwriting gates or house EV will be negative at pool rates.
meta.data_basis: BTS Reporting Carrier OTP winter+summer month empirical; selective underwriting required

takeoff_delay.definition: Actual gate-out minus published scheduled departure (CRS). Not wheels-off.

arrival_delay.definition: Actual gate-in / block-in minus published scheduled arrival (CRS). Not wheels-on.

thresholds.rule: Traveler selects one threshold per stub. Premium is FIXED for the product; payout B scales with selected threshold. Stub pays B if observed delay_minutes >= selected threshold; else 0. (Single-tier payout, not cumulative.)

load_and_edge.formula: pi = lambda * E[payout] = lambda * p_hat(delay >= tau) * B(tau)
load_and_edge.note: Locked pi is NOT equal to lambda*E[payout] at US pool-average p; lambda is enforced via underwriting gates on p_hat.

underwriting_gates.description: Refuse listing / HOT if flight-level p_hat exceeds these caps. Caps derived from locked pi, B, and target lambda.

pool_average_prior_bts_2024_jan_jul.warning: Using pool priors with locked pi yields negative house EV — do not price random flights.

inventory.note: max exposure ≈ inventory_cap * max(B) = inventory * 200; default 10 => $2000

portfolio_exposure_limits.description: Hard caps on simultaneous open stub max-payout exposure. Weather watch airports reduce remaining capacity by multiplier.

HOT.meaning: Flight risk elevated vs underwriting prior (delay already developing, weather watch, or p_hat above soft warn).
HOT.action: Refuse new purchases; existing stubs remain.

CUTOFF.meaning: Past purchase deadline relative to scheduled departure.

FULL.meaning: Inventory stubs for this flight/product exhausted.

DUPLICATE.meaning: Same user already holds an open stub for this flight+product (or same itinerary).

EXPOSURE_CAP.meaning: Portfolio or cluster exposure limit would be exceeded.

UNDERWRITE_REJECT.meaning: Flight-level p_hat exceeds p_max for selected product/tau at target lambda.
UNDERWRITE_REJECT.action: Do not list or refuse purchase.

CANCELLED.meaning: Flight cancelled — stub rules: refund premium (recommended MVP) or separate cancel product.

DIVERTED.meaning: Diversion — Arrival product: treat as trigger at max B or manual review; Takeoff may still settle on gate-out delay.

future_depositor_pool.concept: Depositors post capital; house edge (lambda - 1) can be shared after reserve; depositors inherit residual after traveler payouts and ops fee.
